summary: Approved with no blocking issues. The plan covers all six task checkboxes in docs/phases/PHASE_10.md. It names concrete tests for both test bullets (every link and image in the four documents resolves; every command in the CLI help appears in the guide), plus an image test and three Playwright tests. It maps each part of `make check && npm --prefix web run build && make e2e && python3 scripts/check_docs.py` to evidence, including that the screenshots come from that run's make e2e. It respects the CLAUDE.md rules: it touches no protected file, uses the scratch e2e server, makes approvals by clicks and edits no ledger rows. It lists the README and docs/phases files it will write, and needs no human decision. I checked its mechanics against the repository. Playwright's testDir picks up e2e/guide.spec.ts, and ../docs/guide/img is the right path from web/. docs/guide/img is not git-ignored. Both close flows (cloud_gate.py and autopilot.py) run `git add -A` after the gate, so the committed images are the ones the gate's make e2e wrote; the tree-clean check runs before the gate commands. The CLI has 14 commands plus the memory group with 6 subcommands, and memory is its only group. There are 12 sub-packages plus the root package README, 13 in all. Existing screenshots are 87 to 553 kB, well above the 20 kB floor. make e2e takes about 12 minutes, against the gate's 60-minute limit per command. The plan is thin on the one-pager and rollback content and gives only Live watch a 1440 × 900 shot (Eval also reflows); none of that would fail the gate. Those points, and slow-machine waits and timeouts, are in the suggestions.
